description: Hand-authored ground truth for rust-minimal synthetic fixture. Every edge is observable in source. Used by the prove-the-instrument gate before running real baselines.
notes: 6 internal CALLS, 2 internal IMPORTS. QNs use FLATTENED mod form matching code-graph's fqn.Compute: `pub mod helpers { fn greet() }` is stored as `<file>.greet`, NOT `<file>.helpers.greet`. Impl scope IS included in caller QNs; inline mod scope is NOT. Verified empirically on 2026-04-24 against indexed adsbd/canstatd graphs — a fn defined in `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { fn icao_uppercased() }` at `adsbd/src/main.rs` is stored by code-graph as `adsbd.src.main.icao_uppercased`, not `adsbd.src.main.tests.icao_uppercased`.
